program.name: ndm_hipass
program.help:
High-pass filter a .dat file (required for spike extraction).
The program uses a median-based (non-linear) filter to minimize spike waveform distortion.
PARAMETERS
# windowHalfWidth
Determines the cutoff frequency
# inputExtension
Extension of the data file read for filtering, without the leading dot (default dat). Point it at an alternative, externally-processed source (e.g. car.dat) to filter that file instead of the raw recording.
